userText: Yesterday I helped my little sister with her drawing. She took my hand and asked me to draw a big house with a garden. We used many colors and laughed a lot. In the evening our mother said the picture was beautiful and put it on the wall.
aiRevision: Yesterday, I helped my little sister draw. She held my hand and asked me to draw a big house with a garden. We used many colors and laughed a lot. In the evening, Mom said the picture was beautiful and hung it on the wall.
errorSentences: 未使用目标词 'free expression'，整段描述的是具体绘画活动，而非表达自由、无拘束创作等核心概念；'our mother' 对A1学习者略显正式，日常口语中更常用 'Mom'；'put it on the wall' 可优化为更自然的 'hung it on the wall'
suggestions: A1学习者需紧扣主题词 'free expression'（自由表达）来写作，例如：'We drew whatever we liked — no rules! That’s free expression.' 建议用简单句直接点明主题，并选用与A1匹配的高频词（如 like, draw, feel happy, no rules），避免脱离主题的细节描写。
